simple.meaning: אֶזְרוֹעַ (ʼezrôwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “the arm.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֶזְרוֹעַ (H248) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 31:22, with occurrences in Job, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶזְרוֹעַ (H248) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֶזְרוֹעַ (H248) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֶזְרוֹעַ (ʼezrôwaʻ) / H248 is traced through Job 31:22, Jeremiah 32:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
